title: adonis phoenicea
intro: Adonis phoenicea, commonly known as the red-hot poker, is a perennial plant species in the family Ranunculaceae. The plant is known for its bright red, bell-shaped flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. Adonis phoenicea is reported to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, contributing to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing pain and inflammation, and protecting against cell damage. The plant contains bioactive constituents like glycosides, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential health benefits.
